page.overview:
Who is Tash Arranda?

Tash Arranda was a human who, along with Zak Arranda, encountered a cult and a mysterious artifact after sneaking off to investigate a cave.

Tash Arranda appeared in "Tales of Villainy: Grave Digger" in the tenth issue of the 2020 Star Wars Adventures comic series by IDW Publishing.
